recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-colored typographic composition featuring large, overlapping block letters on the left and a grid of rounded, translucent speech-bubble-like containers on the right, all set against a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale overlapping display type vs. small-scale structured list
Translucent color overlays creating secondary hues at intersections
Playful, irregular geometric shapes containing secondary text
High-contrast primary and secondary color palette against white space
coreInvariants: Rounded-corner rectangular containers with varying stroke weights
Multi-colored letterforms within a single word
White negative space as a grounding element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Dominant display typography occupies the left two-thirds; a staggered grid of text bubbles occupies the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored 'BIG' text in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down through the large display type, then scans the right-side bubbles in a zig-zag pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background provides breathing room between dense typographic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bold primary red, blue, and green for large display type.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, pink, and cyan for secondary containers and smaller text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with uniform brightness to maintain a playful, energetic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Use flat, translucent colors for overlaps

letterConstructionRules: Display type features thick, uneven strokes and rounded terminals
Secondary text uses a condensed, uniform-width sans-serif
Intentional slight misalignment for a hand-cut feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a large, square dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, irregular display type paired with clean, functional condensed sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular bubbles with thick, colored outlines

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, irregular retro display feel
Provides the necessary clean contrast for the list items

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white canvas with a series of overlapping, translucent rounded-rectangle bubbles in pink, yellow, cyan, and red, arranged in a staggered grid on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, multi-colored slab-serif display text on the left with translucent overlaps. Place centered, condensed black sans-serif text inside each of the bubbles on the right.

verificationChecks: Check that overlapping colors create new hues.
Ensure display text is significantly larger than bubble text.
Verify that all bubbles have thick, colored outlines and white fills.
Confirm the background remains pure white.

adjustableVariables: Degree of overlap in display type

mustAchieve: Legible secondary text despite small scale
Dynamic sense of depth through transparency
avoid: Inconsistent stroke weights in display type

postGenerationChecks: Are the colors bright and saturated?
Is the transparency effect visible where letters and shapes overlap?
Is the layout balanced between the heavy left side and the modular right side?
Does the typography feel playful rather than strictly formal?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Large Overlapping Translucent Display Type] on the left with [Staggered Grid of Rounded Outlined Bubbles] on the right, using a [Primary/Secondary Pop Palette] on a [White Background].
